brand.name: Vantera
brand.vibe: Modern, Minimalist, Awwwards-Level, Editorial Tech, Anti-Template

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use solid stark colors with subtle 1px borders.
The Vermilion accent is strictly for kinetic triggers (hover states, active dots, manifesto numbers).
Never use pure black #000000. Use Deep Obsidian (#050505) for organic depth.
Borders must be #1E1E20 to create the architectural 'Swiss' grid feeling.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-[0.85] uppercase

rules: Masked line-by-line reveal for H1 in the hero section is MANDATORY.
Never center-align headings. Always left-align to maintain the architectural grid.
Use IBM Plex Mono for technical metadata, timestamps, or small structural labels.
Use massive gaps (gap-8 to gap-16) for macro-layout.
Implement asymmetrical bento layouts for the Selected Work section (e.g., col-span-8 next to col-span-4).
Leave empty grid cells to create dramatic negative space. Tension creates interest.

patterns.smooth_scroll: Wrap the app in Lenis for premium momentum scrolling.
patterns.masked_reveal: For hero text: Wrap each line in overflow-hidden. Animate inner text from y: '100%' to y: '0%' with a custom cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1) duration 1.2s.
patterns.image_clip: For product photography: Reveal images using clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0) on scroll.
patterns.parallax: Use Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform for a subtle Y-axis parallax on the Hero images.

rules: Motion must feel heavy and deliberate. No bouncy or springy easings. Use slow, friction-heavy cubic-beziers.

visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial band using react-fast-marquee. Text should be massive, outline-only (text-transparent border-white), moving slowly across the screen.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use the 'Technical Look': border-collapse layouts for the Manifesto section, exposing the grid structure.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the viewport with pointer-events-none and 3% opacity to kill digital flatness.

component_styling.buttons: Sharp edges, zero border-radius. Background transparent with 1px border. On hover, background fills with bone_white, text turns black. Use Framer Motion for the fill animation.
component_styling.inputs: Shadcn UI customized: zero border-radius, background transparent, border-b only (underlined inputs). Focus state removes border-b and adds 1px solid bone_white border around.
component_styling.cards: Flat solid surfaces (#0F0F11). 1px subtle border. No shadows. Image containers within cards should have no padding.

home.hero: Kinetic layout. Left side: Massive masked line-reveal text ('ENGINEERING', 'THE INTELLIGENCE', 'OF TOMORROW'). Right side/Background: Subtle 3D mesh or deeply blurred abstract architectural photo with Y-axis parallax.
home.editorial_marquee: Massive outlined text moving slowly: 'AI PLATFORMS — DATA TOOLING — PRODUCT ENGINEERING — '
home.selected_work: Asymmetrical Tetris Grid. Spotlight product photography. Images are clipped and scale up slightly (1.05) on hover.
home.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03). Grid borders exposed. Left column contains huge Vermilion number, right column contains philosophical text about human-centered tech.
home.footer: Massive text 'VANTERA'. Grid alignment, technical links.

services.layout: List-based structural approach. Each service is a massive horizontal row with a top border. Hovering the row reveals a clipped image anchored to the cursor (Framer Motion).

about.layout: Editorial magazine style. Two-column text layout for the vision. High-contrast architectural office photography.

contact.layout: Split screen. Left: Huge typography 'INITIATE'. Right: Functional form (Name, Email, Company, Message). Underlined inputs. Must connect to backend to save data.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue architectural geometry for subtle background parallax
Red Sony headphones on dark surface for high-contrast showcase
Minimalist black and white bottles balancing
Minimalist modern office space for the About page

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind configuration but map the CSS variables strictly.
Implement the Contact form with a working backend route using FastAPI. Save data to a simple local JSON or SQLite file.
DO NOT use generic centered text blocks. Keep typography aligned left, heavy, and structured.
Inject fonts via Google Fonts in index.html: Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare API) and IBM Plex Sans/Mono (from Google Fonts).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
Never use transparent backgrounds for the global header dropdowns or nav menus if content scrolls under them. Use solid #050505.
Ensure 'react-router-dom' is used to link Home, Services, About, and Contact pages seamlessly.
universal_guidelines: Avoid the 'AI slop' look: no generic gradients, no rounded cartoonish buttons. Sharp, editorial, high-end.
Ensure layering through z-index for the marquee and overlapping grid elements.
All transitions should apply specifically to properties (e.g., transition-colors) and exclude transforms to avoid conflict with framer-motion.
Micro-animations are mandatory: hover states on cards, links, and buttons.
Images must not use placeholders. Use the provided URLs.
